reason: Expert gives a confirmed troubleshooting rule for a microwave link losing signal after a storm.

knowledge.summary: After a storm, a microwave link with low signal is usually caused by loose mount bolts rather than a broken radio; check and tighten the mount bolts and realign the dish.
knowledge.author: Jari Jänne
knowledge.details: Two bolts loose on the pole mount, dish turned a bit.
